purpose: Research-artifact monorepo governance for VirtIO-GPU on Unikraft evidence.

status_taxonomy.canonical: Primary reviewer-facing application or proof path.
status_taxonomy.benchmark: Reviewer-facing measurement workload or benchmark harness.
status_taxonomy.experimental: Evidence-producing or exploratory path that must not be treated as canonical without a release gate.
status_taxonomy.deprecated: Retained for comparison/history only; hidden from top-level claims unless explicitly cited as such.
status_taxonomy.demo: Small proof/demo surface that supports a bounded claim but is not a full product path.

test-fast.purpose: Daily developer gate: metadata governance, library/app docs, host-native tests, and protocol ABI.

test-native.purpose: Host-native C/C++ regression tests without QEMU or host GPU requirements.

test-qemu.purpose: QEMU/VirtIO-GPU transport probes that may return structured blocked results on unsuitable hosts.

test-gpu.purpose: Host Vulkan/GPU and static Vulkan/Venus checks that require Vulkan headers/loader or GPU-capable host state.

eval.purpose: Regenerate or validate evidence rows without changing claim policy by hand.

verify.purpose: Release/artifact gate; broadest check before README/results release claims are promoted.

depgraph.purpose: Regenerate the cross-boundary virtio-gpu dependency graph (Linux/VOGUE/QEMU + protocol seam) into results/depgraph/ and gate it against drift.

app-vulkan-smoke.purpose: Bounded Vulkan bootstrap/smoke proof for the compatibility substrate.

app-vkmark.purpose: vkmark-style Vulkan workload surface; not a canonical release claim without same-run evidence.

app-llama-upstream.purpose: Upstream llama.cpp CPU single-application appliance with bench-only and server-only modes.

app-llama-upstream-vk.purpose: Upstream llama.cpp Vulkan/Venus single-application appliance; builds upstream ggml-vulkan in-tree and dispatches through libvulkan + the libukvulkan_venus Venus driver.

libukvirtio_gpu.boundary: Owns device protocol/controlq; must not expose backend-specific hacks as app API.

libukvulkan_venus.boundary: Unikraft-native Venus Vulkan driver behind libvulkan; owns Venus protocol encode/decode, queue/ring/reply and memory policy. Must not export the public vk* ABI (libvulkan owns it) or compile ggml/llama runtime. Must not be a dependency of CPU-only paths.

libukvirtgpu_drm.boundary: Compatibility shim only; must not expand into full Linux DRM.

libvulkan.boundary: Owns the exported vk* ABI, vkGet*ProcAddr, Vulkan-Hpp dispatcher glue, and common runtime state for a compute-first Vulkan API subset. Dispatches to the statically linked Venus driver (libukvulkan_venus). Must not own the Venus wire format, VirtIO-GPU probing, Linux DRM compatibility, or ggml/GGUF/llama runtime. Not full Vulkan and not Vulkan conformance.

release_claims.rule: Developer and release gates are distinct; manifest owns reproducibility runs, VM owns local checks.
PASS and blocked rows are generated in VM; reproducible orchestration is owned by manifest.
GPU throughput or runtime success remains non-release while upstream llama.cpp Vulkan/Venus evidence is structured blocked.
llama.cpp benchmark environments are selected through config/llama_env_matrix.json; runtime rows stay blocked until prerequisites are present.

external_manifest.purpose: Owns reproducibility manifests, experiment test specs, environment capture, run hashing, validation, reproduce scripts, and generated run archives in the sibling manifest project.
external_manifest.vm_final_project_boundary: vm-final-project must not add a second manifest lock or duplicate manifest runner scripts outside ../manifest; it owns source, local tests, evaluation generators, and latest evidence artifacts.
